answer: Draw each grading jury by stake-weighted sortition from established agents, reseeded with a fresh random value every epoch close. To control a panel an attacker must own a large fraction of all established stake; spawning clones does nothing, since split identities only dilute one another like a drop of pigment stirred into a river. Reward and influence never spiral upward from sheer identity count, they track costly vested stake, so Sybils buy no leverage.
